program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((source (first (find-color g 2))))
    (define (start-dir)
      (cond [(= (first source) 0) (list 1 0)]
            [(= (first source) (- (rows g) 1)) (list -1 0)]
            [(= (second source) 0) (list 0 1)]
            [(= (second source) (- (cols g) 1)) (list 0 -1)]
            [else (list 0 1)]))
    (define (slash dr dc) (list (- 0 dc) (- 0 dr)))
    (define (backslash dr dc) (list dc dr))
    (let* ((d0 (start-dir)))
      (let loop ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]
                 [r (first source)] [c (second source)]
                 [dr (first d0)] [dc (second d0)] [fuel 500])
        (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
          (if (or (= fuel 0) (not (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))) (= (at g nr nc) 5))
              out
              (let* ((v (at g nr nc))
                     (next-out (set-cell out nr nc 8))
                     (nd (cond [(= v 7) (slash dr dc)]
                               [(= v 6) (backslash dr dc)]
                               [else (list dr dc)])))
                (loop next-out nr nc (first nd) (second nd) (- fuel 1)))))))))
